The '''Ootana family''' was a family of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] that was part of the [[Hu'un]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Its members led safaris into the [[Duros Sector|Old Duros Sector]], a dangerous area of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was overrun by deadly creatures. The family made sure that the kajidic had no responsibility for injuries or deaths that occurred during safaris.<ref name="LoNH" />
